question: Under NERC Reliability Standard PRC-024 as in effect on 2024-09-30, when during a disturbance the voltage at the high side of the step-up transformer of a generating plant in the Western Interconnection, on a 230 kV transmission system, rises to 266 kV, what is the Minimum Time (sec) in the voltage boundary data points for that voltage? If no such requirement applies on that date, answer not_in_effect.
Under MISO BPM-007 as in effect on 2026-07-13, what is the time after the operating hour for NAIs? If no such requirement applies on that date, answer not_in_effect.

answer.value: two (2) business days prior to coverage period start by 08:00 EST

question: Under IESO-MM-7.3 as in effect on 2026-04-30, when a generation facility that the IESO has classed as non-critical equipment needs a planned derate running from 20:00 on 2026-05-12 to 04:00 on 2026-05-13, and the unit would need about an hour to be recalled, what is the submission requirement, in business days before the start of the coverage period? If no such requirement applies on that date, answer not_in_effect.

Under AESO ISO Rules Section 503.17 as in effect on 2025-11-13, when a revenue meter commissioned before the start of last year recorded 219,000 MWh of total active energy at its measurement point over last calendar year, a year of 8,760 settlement intervals, at least once every how many years must the legal owner of the revenue meter perform in-situ testing? If no such requirement applies on that date, answer not_in_effect.

answer.value: five (5) business days prior to coverage period start
